answers.question: What do I need to get a passport for the first time?
answers.answer: If you are over 18: proof of payment (online, at a partner bank, or at the office) and a valid physical or digital ID card; if you are renewing, your previous passport. In Quito, Guayaquil and Cuenca it is issued the same day; at other offices, within 24 to 72 hours.

answers.question: Were there any strong earthquakes in Ecuador this week?
answers.answer: The strongest within Ecuadorian territory was magnitude 4.8, 45.7 km from Salinas (Santa Elena), on November 7 at 17:17, at a depth of 2.4 km. There was also a 3.7 near Pasaje (El Oro).

answers.question: How much money do migrants send to Ecuador?
answers.answer: In 2025, remittances reached US$ 7,728 million, 18.2% more than in 2024 (US$ 6,540 million). In the second quarter of 2026, US$ 2,041 million arrived.
answers.source: Central Bank of Ecuador · Balance of payments

answers.answer: Yes, 3 active notices. For example: Monday, November 9, from 09:00 to 14:00, in the Callate San Antonio neighborhood (Píllaro); Tuesday, November 10, from 10:00 to 14:00, in the La Libertad neighborhood (Puyo).

answers.question: What percentage of households have internet in Manta?
answers.answer: According to the 2022 Census, 65.0% of households in Manta have fixed internet (66.6% in urban areas and 33.1% in rural areas), compared with 47.4% in Manabí and 60.9% nationwide.

answers.question: Where is the 2022 Census data on household internet access?
answers.answer: In the «Information technologies» tabulation of the 2022 Census (03_2022_CPV_TIC.xlsx), with households by internet, computer and cell phone availability by province, canton and parish.
